definitions.name: Highly qualified work route check
public_limitations: A route match is a bounded source-based screening result, not legal advice or an application decision.
External authority, recognition, sponsorship, quota, and discretionary requirements keep first-wave matches conditional.
No conclusion is made about routes outside the frozen named-route inventory.
definitions.refresh_cadence: Before every evidence release and at least quarterly.
definitions.supported_profile_boundary: Guest-entered occupation, qualification, explicit job-offer state, citizenship where relevant, destination, and snapshot date.
definitions.user_question: Which supported highly qualified work route appears to match this declared snapshot?

definitions.name: Dependants on supported work and study routes
public_limitations: A route match is a bounded source-based screening result, not legal advice or an application decision.
External authority, recognition, sponsorship, quota, and discretionary requirements keep first-wave matches conditional.
No conclusion is made about routes outside the frozen named-route inventory.
This is not a general family-reunification check and does not establish partner work rights.
definitions.refresh_cadence: Before every evidence release and at least quarterly.
definitions.supported_profile_boundary: Declared partner relationship category and dependent-child roles attached only to a frozen first-wave primary route.
definitions.user_question: Do declared partner or dependent-child roles conditionally fit a supported primary work or study route?

definitions.name: Post-study stay and work route check
public_limitations: A route match is a bounded source-based screening result, not legal advice or an application decision.
External authority, recognition, sponsorship, quota, and discretionary requirements keep first-wave matches conditional.
No conclusion is made about routes outside the frozen named-route inventory.
Planned future completion remains provisional and institution or program eligibility is never inferred.
definitions.refresh_cadence: Before every evidence release and at least quarterly.
definitions.supported_profile_boundary: Declared institution identity, qualification, study duration/mode, completion state, destination, and snapshot date.
definitions.user_question: Does this declared study scenario conditionally fit a supported post-study stay or work route?
